The domain_sources claim ("involve the current manager") is stretched to back an automatic alert at submit, which the source contradicts. On a hiring product, a form that tells an employee's boss the moment they apply is also exactly what HR would object to. -> Keep the application confidential at submit and bring the current manager in where the source puts it. For example, H3 "Internal moves stay confidential until the final round"; body: employees apply with their ID and months in role (keep the 12-month check), the application goes to the internal table and the hiring manager, and the current manager gets the Slack direct message only when the applicant reaches a final interview.
